equity_bridge.item: Yiye Biotechnology 29% step-up consideration (committed Aug-2026, internal funds)
equity_bridge.note: Cash leaves after the balance-sheet date; the resulting lower NCI leakage is in cash_tax_rate_path. Optional further 5% (to RMB500m total) not assumed.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: cycle-adjusted: base-case 10-year revenue path CAGR (FY2025 -> FY2035), not a historical CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 19.0% diverges >30% from revenue (50.8%) and EPS (88.9%) 3yr CAGRs. All historical CAGRs are measured FY2021/22 -> FY2025 peak and are inflated by the FY2022 trough (COVID lockdowns) and the Dec-2022 IPO proceeds in equity; H1 FY2026 revenue -8.6% and parent NP -77% show they are not a forward guide. Selected rate is the base-case path CAGR instead.
historical_growth.notes: Only five annual years exist (FY2021-FY2025), so 5yr CAGRs are null and 4yr (FY2021->FY2025) are given. Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest income: FY2021 230.2, FY2022 -17.7, FY2023 648.9 (658.3-5.0-9.4; IPO-year working-capital release), FY2024 301.0, FY2025 677.7. The 3yr owner-FCF CAGR is undefined (negative FY2022 base). Owner-FCF 4yr CAGR (31.0%) is above reported FCF CAGR (26.2%) only because FY2021 SBC (RMB41.4m pre-IPO grant) was unusually large; SBC is not growing faster than cash flow. FY2025 FCF is struck after RMB514m capex (5.6% of revenue, capacity build) -- maintenance capex is ~3%.

scenario_narratives.base: KANS's H1 FY2026 -20% is partly cyclical (a Douyin traffic-cost spike shared by Proya) and partly real share loss to Mao Geping and resurgent foreign premium brands. KANS stabilises at a lower level from 2027 while newpage and ARMIYO keep compounding, so group revenue bottoms at ~RMB8.4bn in FY2026 and regains the FY2025 peak only around FY2030. The S&D ratio settles near 60%, giving a 14% mid-cycle EBITDA margin -- well below the 17% FY2025 peak -- on a fixed-cost base permanently enlarged by the new plant and lease. Capex normalises to ~3% after FY2026, so owner FCF recovers to ~RMB0.8bn by FY2029.
scenario_narratives.bull: Management's July-2026 KANS recovery is real: the H1 air pocket was a marketing-cycle reset (gross margin actually rose to 76.7%), newpage/ARMIYO keep growing 50%+ and diversify KANS below 60% of revenue, and the new automated capacity delivers operating leverage. Revenue grows high single digits from FY2027 and EBITDA margin returns to ~17% (FY2025 peak level) by FY2030 as S&D intensity falls back toward 55-57%. C-beauty keeps taking share of the ~RMB1.1tn China market from multinationals.
scenario_narratives.bear: The H1 decline is structural: KANS has lost its Douyin algorithm/KOL edge to Mao Geping and foreign brands' flexible discounting, and must keep spending ~65% of revenue on S&D to defend a shrinking base. Revenue falls another 4% in FY2027 and only creeps back at ~2%; EBITDA margin is stuck at 9-10% (the FY2022 trough level) with the enlarged plant under-absorbed. Dividends are cut to fund capex and the Yiye step-up, and the RMB361m of new borrowings becomes a constraint rather than a choice.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Mid-cycle normalisation, not peak extrapolation. FY2025's 17% EBITDA margin and +35% revenue were bought with a 42% rise in marketing spend; H1 FY2026 showed what happens when that spend stops converting. The base case values Chicmax as a ~14%-margin, low-single-digit-growth C-beauty platform on a fixed-cost base enlarged by new capacity, with a 12x terminal cap appropriate to a structurally competitive, trend-driven category. Net cash is roughly offset by the new leases and the committed Yiye step-up, so value is almost entirely the operating flows.
key_risks_to_valuation: KANS revenue trajectory: each 5pp of group growth in FY2027-28 moves base value materially because the fixed-cost base (D&A ~3% of revenue, up from ~1.5%) amplifies volume swings
S&D intensity: the difference between a 57% and a 66% S&D ratio is roughly the difference between the bull and bear margin paths
Douyin algorithm / KOL dependence and C-beauty competition (Mao Geping, Proya) plus foreign premium brands' discounting
Capital allocation: further Yiye step-up (option to RMB500m total), new factory spend, and a dividend policy that paid out >50% of profit at the peak
FX: per-share values convert RMB to HKD at 1.1724; a 5% RMB move moves the HKD value 5%
Governance: founder-controlled (combined Chair/CEO, ~48% held via unlisted shares), ex-Proya strategy chief departed after ~11 months

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (2145.HK) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range HK$20.0-99.0
data_sources.financials: 2145.HK_Metrics.csv (FY2021-FY2025 annual reports, H1 FY2023-FY2026 interims) plus the H1 FY2026 interim report balance sheet and cash-flow statement (2145.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt lines 2583-2665, 2803-2882) for cash, pledged deposits, FVTPL assets, borrowings, leases, NCI and D&A
data_sources.qualitative: 2145.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-17): brand mix, H1 FY2026 profit warning, Yiye acquisition, third-party FY2026 consensus (~RMB8.7bn revenue, not company guidance)

inputs.share_count_basis: 398,128,442 shares in issue at 30 Jun 2026 (191,752,560 Unlisted Shares + 206,375,882 H Shares, same ordinary class; H1 FY2026 interim report). Basic = diluted per the interim EPS line. Held FLAT: SBC (RSU scheme, ~0.1% of revenue) is expensed in the flows; no buybacks, no non-SBC issuance planned.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash-flow statement share-based payment add-back (RMB8.8m); no net-share-settlement tax line (EquityAwardTaxes 0 every period)
inputs.fx_note: Flows and statements in RMB (CNY); H shares quote in HKD. CNY->HKD 1.1724 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-16 22:02Z; cross-check 1/HKDCNY=X 0.8505 (2026-10-17 02:32Z) = 1.1758, 0.3% tie, direction confirmed (1 RMB buys more than 1 HKD). No A-share or ADR listing to parity-check against. Per-share values are computed in CNY then multiplied by 1.1724 for the canonical HKD keys.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' own currency. China 10y CGB ~1.8%, ERP 7.0% for a PRC consumer-discretionary issuer listed in HK, beta ~1.1 (discretionary, single-platform Douyin demand) -> cost of equity ~9.5-10%; the group is net cash ex leases so WACC ~= CoE. 10.0% used, identical across scenarios: cyclicality, KANS concentration and the competitive-erosion risk are carried in the scenario flows and the 30% bear weight, not in a WACC premium (risk charged once). Terminal growth 2.0% base reflects China's low nominal-growth/deflationary consumer backdrop.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB334.9m at 30 Jun 2026 (current 26.9 + non-current 308.0, mostly the new RMB325m factory lease signed FY2025) are inside total_debt/net_debt; lease principal (FY2025 RMB59.4m) is NOT deducted from flows; right-of-use depreciation (~RMB47m/yr annualised) sits inside the D&A path and the capex path carries a renewal allowance. Lease interest is a financing item and not charged in the flows.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, attributable-basis via leakage: NCI took 4.5% of FY2025 profit and 14% of H1 FY2026 profit (Yiye Biotechnology at 51% plus small JVs). The Aug-2026 agreement lifts Yiye to 80% for RMB384m (the further 5% option, up to RMB500m total, not assumed), which roughly halves the NCI share going forward. The cash_tax_rate_path of 22.5% = ~20% PRC effective cash tax (HNTE 15% subsidiaries blended with 25% statutory; FY2025 book ETR 17.3%, H1 FY2026 19.5%) plus ~3% NCI profit leakage on post-tax EBIT. The RMB384m consideration is deducted in the equity_bridge as committed cash out; NCI book stock (RMB124.8m) is NOT also deducted.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (component route) with non-US adaptations, per dcf-methods routing -- Chicmax is a multi-brand PRC skincare manufacturer/marketer (KANS ~71% of revenue) with real free cash flow; no bank/REIT/holdco features. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY entry). FY0 = FY2025 (peak year); Y1 = FY2026, which is already half-reported (H1 revenue -8.6%, parent NP -77%). Year 1 is discounted a full period although Dec-2026 is ~2.5 months away -- a small conservatism kept for cross-ticker comparability. NO INCOME-STATEMENT EBITDA: HKFRS presentation has no operating-profit subtotal, so EBITDA was rebuilt as PBT + finance costs + D&A - interest income - fair-value gains: FY2021 ~14.3%, FY2022 ~10%, FY2023 ~15.7%, FY2024 ~15.2%, FY2025 ~17.2%, H1 FY2026 ~9.0% (H1 FY2025 ~18.3%). Mid-cycle ~14% is the base terminal margin, explicitly below the FY2025 peak, because the S&D ratio (56.9% -> 66.1%) shows customer-acquisition cost inflation that is industry-wide (Proya too), not a one-off. SBC-near-zero market: SBC rows kept explicit at 0.1% of revenue; house and street differ only trivially. Buybacks: none ever (non-repurchaser); the flat count is a modelling convention matched by an immaterial RSU scheme. Net debt bridge (30 Jun 2026): cash 686.0 + pledged deposits 5.0 = 691.0; bank borrowings 361.0 (299.9 current + 61.1 non-current) + leases 334.9 = 695.9; net debt +4.9. FVTPL financial assets (146.9) are in the equity_bridge; their fair-value gains/losses are excluded from the EBITDA rebuild (matching-asset rule). Dividends: RMB609m paid FY2025, no interim declared for H1 FY2026.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 -8%: H1 -8.6% reported, H2 assumed ~-7.5% (Double-11 weighted half; management's 'gradual recovery since July' is unverified, and third-party consensus of ~RMB8.7bn (-5%) is treated as an upper bound). FY2027 +3% as newpage/ARMIYO (+60%/+89% in H1) offset a KANS that stabilises but does not regrow; 5% in FY2028-29 as the portfolio diversifies; fades to 2.5% by FY2035.
base.margin_rationale: Rebuilt EBITDA margin H1 FY2026 ~9%, so FY2026 full-year ~10%. Recovers to a 14% mid-cycle by FY2029 -- the FY2021-FY2025 average ex-peak -- not to the 17.2% FY2025 peak. Gross margin (76.7%) is intact; the gap is the S&D ratio, assumed to settle near 60% of revenue, between FY2024 (~57%) and H1 FY2026 (66%).
base.capex_rationale: FY2026 4.8% (H1 capex RMB208m, Fengxian upgrade and new factory completion), stepping to ~3% maintenance plus lease-renewal allowance; D&A % stays elevated at ~2.8-3.2% because the new plant and RMB325m lease are fixed costs now in the base.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default: single-brand (KANS ~71%) and single-platform (Douyin) dependence, a 77% profit collapse whose cause management describes only as 'periodic market factors', the interim dividend suspended, and sector-wide S&D inflation at peer Proya. Base 50% because gross margin is intact and newpage/ARMIYO are genuinely diversifying. Bull cut to 20% because it needs the unverified July recovery AND a fall in S&D intensity AND operating leverage on new capacity to all go right.
probability_weighted.band_note: Band collapsed: SBC is ~0.1% of revenue (RSU scheme, RMB1-9m/yr), so house and street differ by ~HK$0.3-0.4/share and price sits outside the sliver; band_position is not meaningful (raw formula gives ~-718%).

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
